answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 820 fakes pays 546 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The zephyr test is the live device, the ocean test is the locked stake, and the crystal test is the graded history no template can fake.
